modmenu.descriptionTranslation.perspecti: A client-side API framework for managing and extending camera perspectives.
perspective.perspective_api.first_person: View the world through your character's eyes
perspective.perspective_api.third_person: View your character from the front
perspective_api.config_screen.title: Perspective API Settings
perspective_api.config_screen.option.mod: Master switch that controls whether all Perspective API features are active. Disable to completely revert to vanilla behavior.
perspective_api.config_screen.option.log: Number of client ticks between perspective logic updates. Higher values reduce processing at the cost of responsiveness.
perspective_api.config_screen.option.tra: Duration of the smooth camera transition when switching perspectives, in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable transitions.
perspective_api.config_screen.option.ble: Exponent applied to the easing curve. Lower values make the transition start faster; higher values delay the start. A value of 1 means no modification.
perspective_api.config_screen.option.swi: Select the switcher used to cycle between perspectives
perspective_api.config_screen.option.orb: Number of ticks the perspective key must be held before the Orbit Switcher wheel menu opens. Set to 0 to open it immediately.
perspective_api.config_screen.fallback.m: Please install YACL to display the config screen
Cycles through available perspectives using the perspective toggle keybind, or opens a radial menu when held
Cycles through enabled perspectives, or opens an editable spatial wheel when the perspective key is held
